summary.name: Video Watermark Remover
summary.one_liner: A web-based tool that uses AI to remove watermarks from uploaded videos (MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV, WMV) and returns a watermark-free file.
use_cases: Remove a TikTok, YouTube or Instagram watermark from a video
Clean up old price overlays in product videos
Remove subtitles or captions burned into a video
Delete a date or time stamp from footage
Remove an unwanted person or object from a video background
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an online tool where users upload a video (up to 100MB, per the upload box) and AI automatically detects and removes the watermark, with output described as HD. It claims the process takes under 2 minutes and that results have no blur. The site also links to related tools for removing text, logos and objects from video. Pricing tiers are listed as Starter, Professional and Business with monthly-style removal quotas (10, 30 and 80 removals), plus features such as API access and batch processing on higher tiers. The page states uploaded files are deleted from the server within 24 hours.
notable: Browser-based AI watermark removal with no software install needed
Claims uploaded files are auto-deleted from servers within 24 hours
Related tools for removing text, logos and objects from video
Paid tiers offer 10, 30 or 80 removals with API access on Business
caveats: Paid tiers list per-plan removal quotas; the page does not clearly state a free allowance despite the 'free' framing
Upload size limited to 100MB per the page
Output quality and the 2-minute processing claim are marketing statements, not independently verified
